"""
    get_time_data(vf::VelocityField, time_step::Int) -> Float64

Get the time data for a specific time step.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The velocity field object
- `time_step::Int`: The time step to retrieve data for

# Returns
- `Float64`: The time value at the specified step
"""
function get_time_data(vf::VelocityField, time_step::Int)
    h5open(vf.file_paths[TIME_DATA_FILE], "r") do file
        time_steps = read(file["time_data"])
        if time_step < 1 || time_step > length(time_steps)
            throw(ArgumentError("Time step $time_step out of range"))
        end
        return time_steps[time_step]
    end
end

function get_time_data(vf::VelocityField, time_step::Int)
